text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
The Japan Cup...
Once again, an incredible lineup has gathered, hasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: The familiar faces Kris S-chan and Tap-chan. And on top of that...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Even Universe-chan!
She just finished the Kikuka Sho, and yet
she's running here too?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
It's almost the exact same lineup of amazing girls
as that 'Takarazuka Kinen'~...
choice_data_list: Doesn't look like we can win?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: No! That's not true at all!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I'm not the same as I used to be.
Even I have a pretty decent amount of ability now!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: But still...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
My dream might be lacking, though.
Everyone else seems to have something grand going on.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I might want to use that as a reference.
I'll be right back~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Delightedly, Hishi Miracle dove right into
the circle of Umamusume burning with dreams.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Alright, everyone! I'd like to ask you all
to take a quick survey."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Kris S-chan's dream is that, right?
The development of the racing world—or in other words, the Umamusume world.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: And also—one more thing.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Repaying my debt to the Symboli family.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: I-I see... So giving back to someone who looked after you can be a dream too.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: What's your dream, Tap-chan?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Ha, it's obvious.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: —In search of a grand romance!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm not sure I understand...
What is it, exactly...?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"You won't know for sure
until you hold it in your own hands."

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Treasure, friendship, or cheers of applause.
As long as a single piece of that remains in my grasp, that's enough for me!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I see~.
And what about Universe-chan?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
A dream... Neo Universe's dream is
——"crystal clear."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Really? Then let's get right to the point!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Initiating "LUZF".

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"W-Whazzat? Louz...?
Dunno what that means, can't even read it."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
The point is—
to "reacquire" it for tracing.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha... Having you explain it might've made me
even more confused. But...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: "So you mean just make it look good somehow...! Thanks, everyone."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: So—what about Hishi Miracle?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"I... still don't know.
That's why..."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I'll try running alongside everyone who has a dream again
and think about it then.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Haha, I see.
I don't mind that head-on way of thinking.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Then come along! In the end, our treasure map
can only ever be found on the track!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, dreamy senpais,
looking forward to working with you today~

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
All right, I'm gonna find one too~!
A super cool dream that I can be proud of, like, "This is it!"
